entities.summary: Postojna Cave is a cave experience destination in Postojna, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: The underground railway and enormous show-cave route make this one of Europe’s most theatrical cave visits despite its mainstream fame. This entry is intended for 5–adult travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
